# Design Document: Duolingo AI Network

**Generated by:** /office-hours
**Date:** 2026-05-16
**Status:** Pre-build validation

---

## 1. Product Identity

**What:** Platform mobile-first yang mentransformasi member MLM menjadi "AI Creator" — bukan sekadar alat bantu caption, tapi ekosistem behavioral transformation ala Duolingo.

**One-liner:** Duolingo untuk menghasilkan uang dengan skill AI.

**Who it's for:**
- **Buyer (B2B):** Pemilik/Direksi MLM yang butuh turnaround perusahaan
- **User (B2C):** Member MLM — dari leader senior (30 orang) hingga member baru yang inactive (11,000+)

**The pain:**
- 92% member inactive setelah bayar join fee — nggak tahu cara jualan
- Member existing (rata-rata orang tua) hanya jualan tatap muka, nggak bisa digital
- Gen Z sama sekali tidak tertarik join MLM model lama
- Perusahaan pasca perpecahan internal — perlu identitas baru

---

## 2. The Behavioral Moat

**Dua layer arsitektur:**

### Layer Deterministik (Traditional Code — no AI)
- XP & Streak calculation
- Leaderboard & Guild ranking
- Affiliate link generation & tracking
- Auth & Wallet — login, data security, earning records

### Layer AI-Native (AI-powered — personalized & dynamic)
- **AI Identity Profiling:** Chat-based onboarding — AI menentukan Archetype user (Silent Builder, Natural Seller, Trend Hunter)
- **Personalized Daily Missions:** Misi harian digenerate AI berdasarkan Archetype + performa historis
- **AI Coaching Memory:** AI menurunkan/menaikkan difficulty berdasarkan streak completion
- **AI Text Tool:** Generator caption & hook yang tone-nya menyesuaikan Archetype user

---

## 3. MVP Scope — Phase 1 (90 Hari)

**WAJIB dibangun:**
1. **Onboarding Chat AI** — Archetype profiling via chat interaktif
2. **Dashboard Gamifikasi** — Daily missions, XP bar, Streak counter
3. **AI Text Tool** — Caption & Hook generator dengan tone per Archetype
4. **Affiliate Referral** — Basic link generation & click tracking

**DILARANG di MVP:**
- AI Video/Image generation
- Payment gateway (klaim manual/WA dulu)
- In-app video editor (TikTok/CapCut sebagai external tool)
- Marketplace digital (Phase 2)

---

## 4. Tech Stack

| Layer | Tech | Alasan |
|---|---|---|
| Frontend | React Native (Expo) | Mobile-first, cross-platform |
| Styling | NativeWind | Tailwind untuk React Native |
| Backend | Supabase | PostgreSQL, Auth, Row-Level Security |
| AI Compute | Supabase Edge Functions | Bungkus OpenAI/Claude API, kredensial aman |
| Real-time | Supabase Realtime | Live leaderboard & mission updates |

---

## 5. User Archetypes (AI-Powered)

| Archetype | Karakteristik | Tipe Misi |
|---|---|---|
| Silent Builder | Introvert, suka desain & tulisan | Bikin carousel Canva, nulis caption edukatif |
| Natural Seller | Ekstrovert, jago ngomong | Bikin video talking-head TikTok, live selling |
| Trend Hunter | Gesit, mengikuti tren | Remix tren TikTok, bikin konten viral pendek |
| Trust Anchor | Senior, punya network kuat | Pairing dengan Gen Z, fokus closing & networking |

---

## 6. Key Design Decisions (dari Office Hours)

1. **Buyer vs User gap:** Owner MLM yang bayar (saham/revenue share), member yang pakai. Interface harus meyakinkan owner (dashboard leader) DAN engaging untuk member (gamifikasi addicting).
2. **Non-tech stakeholder:** Owner tidak bisa "membayangkan" produk dari 1 fitur. MVP harus langsung terasa utuh — onboarding → dashboard → misi → hasil.
3. **Offline-to-digital bridge:** Member existing jualan offline. Jangan paksa mereka langsung bikin TikTok. Misi harus dimulai dari hal sederhana: copy-paste caption WA dulu, baru naik ke konten visual.
4. **Gen Z gateway:** Bukan mengubah member existing, tapi menarik Gen Z via sistem pairing (Senior x Junior Hybrid Guild — Phase 2).
5. **300M stok lama:** Strategi bundling — stok jadi "tiket masuk" ke Internal AI Academy, bukan sekadar clearance sale.

---

## 7. Risk Register

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Perusahaan collapse sebelum MVP selesai | High | Scope ketat Phase 1, nggak boleh scope creep |
| Member nggak mau pakai app digital | Medium | Misi pertama super sederhana (WA caption), gamifikasi addictive |
| Owner non-tech ganti requirement terus | High | PRD harus disetujui & freeze sebelum build. Kontrak scope tertulis. |
| Saham/revenue share tidak likuid | High | Pastikan perjanjian legal sebelum mulai coding. Jangan bangun tanpa MoU. |
| 92% inactive — realitanya lebih susah diaktifkan | Medium | Fokus ke 1,000 member aktif dulu sebagai early adopters |

---

## 8. Success Metrics (Phase 1)

- **Aktivasi:** 200/1,000 member aktif download & selesaikan onboarding dalam 30 hari
- **Engagement:** 30% DAU (Daily Active Users) menyelesaikan minimal 1 misi/hari
- **Content output:** 500+ konten (caption/video) dihasilkan via AI Text Tool di bulan pertama
- **Revenue signal:** Minimal 10 member dapat "small win" (Rp25rb-100rb) lewat affiliate link
